CHANGES (list ALL modifications, one or multiple):

Change #1: [Category: Model Architecture]
- What: In model_design, add one pre-normalized causal self-attention layer with two heads after the existing convolution blocks and before final_norm, using hidden size 96, attention dropout 0.25, and a residual connection. Mask padding keys and future positions, safely handle fully padded query positions, and update the predictor writer to instantiate this architecture from its single checkpoint.
- Why: Content-dependent attention lets the network retrieve relevant earlier purchases directly when intervening purchases are less informative, complementing the convolution stack’s fixed temporal filters.

---

WHY current solution limited:
- Root cause: The convolution-only backbone routes historical information through fixed dilation patterns; it lacks an explicit mechanism to select earlier items according to their relevance to the current context.
- Evidence: The current trial reaches macro validation HR@10 of 0.4987 versus the SASRec baseline’s 0.505, with Electronics falling from 0.42 to 0.36; this motivates testing adaptive historical retrieval, although these results do not establish the cause.

HOW these changes address it:
- Mechanism: Causal attention operates on learned convolutional features and assigns context-dependent weights across the available history, while the residual connection preserves the existing local sequence representation.
- Expected improvement: Predict a macro HR@10 increase of approximately 0.005–0.015 over the current trial, with Electronics the primary category to inspect; accept or reject this hypothesis using the independent host validation results.
- Synergy: Convolutions encode local sequential patterns, and the added attention layer retrieves relevant patterns across the window within the same jointly trained network.

KEEP UNCHANGED (must explicitly list):
- Random seed: Preprocessing seed 0 and training seed 42, including the existing worker seeding.
- Data split: Identical supplied training and validation files; no test-file access or validation targets used in training.
- Data handling: DATA_DIR remains os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; retain all four categories, dataset routing, and trial-local artifacts.
- Model and loss: Retain the convolution blocks, item embeddings, jointly learned item bias, sampled-softmax objective, 256 negatives, and 2,048-token loss cap.
- Training: Retain random-prefix sampling, maximum history length 64, batch size 128, 200 steps per epoch, environment-controlled 200-epoch default, optimizer, learning-rate schedule, gradient clipping, and checkpoint-selection policy.
- Evaluation: Retain validation HR@10 with 200 users per category, 99 unique negative candidates, evaluation seed 42, and macro averaging; validation and deployed inference use the same model.predict processing.
- Single-model constraint: Train one independent network per category and load exactly one selected checkpoint per category, with no averaging or separately fitted scoring components; keep execution on one GPU within the existing runtime limit.
